Lily drinks water after doing sports. It takes twenty minutes to get to the library desk by bike. Lily thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. The bookstore stays open until ten.
Lily plays volleyball with Sam every Monday. Sam is interested in singing. There are always many people at the neighborhood station. The test confirmed a duodenal ulcer.
Both of them like rice and water. Last Monday, Lily and Sam went to the library desk. Lily learned a lot about science. The sun disappeared below the hills.
Lily hopes to visit London one day. Lily wrote about the day in the diary. Lily spent the weekend at the supermarket.
